title: Movies per genre
statementMd:
Count movies in each genre.

Expected columns: `genre`, `movies`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS movies FROM movies GROUP BY genre;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
